filer_name.rationale: Filer name is a header field not represented as a data element in the Schedule F canonical schema.

filer_identifying_number.rationale: Filer TIN is a header field not represented as a data element in the Schedule F canonical schema.

tax_year_begin.rationale: Accounting period begin date is a header field not represented as a data element in the Schedule F canonical schema.

tax_year_end.rationale: Accounting period end date is a header field not represented as a data element in the Schedule F canonical schema.

schedule_f_functional_currency.rationale: Functional currency code is a header field not present in the closed candidate list for Schedule F.

schedule_f_exchange_rate.rationale: Exchange rate is a header field not present in the closed candidate list for Schedule F.

cash.rationale: Schedule F line 1 cash maps to EndAcctPrdCashAmt (end-of-year balance sheet cash amount).

trade_notes_accounts_receivable.rationale: Schedule F line 2a trade notes and accounts receivable maps to EndAcctPrdTradeNotesAmt.

allowance_for_bad_debts.rationale: Schedule F line 2b allowance for bad debts maps to EndAcctPrdBadDebtAllwncAmt.

inventories.rationale: Schedule F line 3 inventories maps to EndAcctPrdInventoriesAmt.

other_current_assets.rationale: Schedule F line 4 other current assets maps to EndAcctPrdOtherCurrAssetsAmt.

loans_to_shareholders.rationale: Schedule F line 5a loans to shareholders maps to EndAcctPrdLoansToShrAmt.

other_investments.rationale: Schedule F line 5b other investments maps to EndAcctPrdOthInvestmentsAmt.

buildings_land_equipment_gross.rationale: Schedule F line 6a buildings and other depreciable assets maps to EndAcctPrdBldgAndOtherAstAmt.

accumulated_depreciation.rationale: Schedule F line 6b accumulated depreciation maps to EndAcctPrdNetAccumDeprecAmt.

other_assets.rationale: Schedule F line 7 other assets maps to EndAcctPrdOtherAssetsAmt.

total_assets.rationale: Schedule F line 8 total assets maps to EndAcctPrdTotalAssetsAmt.

accounts_payable.rationale: Schedule F line 9 accounts payable maps to EndAcctPrdAccountsPayableAmt.

other_current_liabilities.rationale: Schedule F line 10 other current liabilities maps to EndAcctPrdOtherCurrLiabAmt.

loans_from_shareholders.rationale: Schedule F line 11 loans from shareholders maps to EndAcctPrdLoansFromShrAmt.

other_liabilities.rationale: Schedule F line 12 other liabilities maps to EndAcctPrdOthLiabilitiesAmt.

capital_stock.rationale: Schedule F line 13 capital stock bundles preferred and common stock; canonical schema splits into EndAcctPrdPreferredStockAmt (idx 57) and EndAcctPrdCommonStockAmt (idx 35) — blueprint should split into two fields or a null is returned because no single element represents combined capital stock.

retained_earnings.rationale: Schedule F line 14 retained earnings maps to EndAcctPrdRtnEarningsAmt.

other_adjustments_account.rationale: Schedule F line 15 other adjustments account is the closest match to EndAcctPrdPaidInOrSurplusAmt (paid-in surplus/capital surplus), though the label fit is approximate.

less_treasury_stock.rationale: Schedule F line 16 cost of treasury stock maps to EndAcctPrdNetCostOfTrStkAmt.

total_liabilities_and_equity.rationale: Schedule F line 17 total liabilities and shareholders' equity maps to EndAcctPrdTotLiabShrEqtyAmt.
